title: Kenya 2019 census population (KNBS)
description: Population by county and sub-county from the 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census.

transfer.rationale: Re-run the ingest against its public origin rather than copying; the ingest is the definition of the dataset.

gaps: KNBS publishes no open licence, so redistribution terms are unresolved.
Cannot be joined at admin 2 - only 183 of 290 sub-counties match the Atlas boundary set.

changelog.change: Record created; back-filled from the existing CDH record and ingest script.
